title: Unit and composition laws of the completed-ring refinement maps

from.place: Proof step 8, refinement unit and composition only, before cofiltered choice independence.

statement: Let (A,I) be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. On each scheme T take D_T = D(Mod(A_T)) for its completed coefficient sheaf. Let J_j be the exact ringed pro-etale extension by zero with its section-normalized adjunction [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], and P_h the canonical derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with the normalized identity/composition comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-completed-ordinary-comparisons]. Let f:X→Y be separated of finite type, and c_i=(j_i:X→Z_i,p_i:Z_i→Y) compactifications [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification], with proper refinements [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For u:c_1→c_2 let Q_u have top j_1, bottom j_2, left 1_X, right u. Define its proper/open gamma as the mate of the Cartesian open comparison followed by the clopen lift projector, with the normalized open units, as in [lem-cbc-proper-open-clopen-projector]. For K∈D_X put F_c(K)=P_p J_j K and define C_u:F_c2(K)→F_c1(K) to be P_p2 applied to J_j2(P_1X≅id)^{-1} followed by gamma_Qu, then the canonical P_u P_p2≅P_(u;p2) and equality u;p2=p1. For every K∈D_X, C_id(c)=id_Fc(K) and C_(u;v)=C_v;C_u for all composable refinements. The maps are exactly cbcRefinementMap, without any replacement isomorphism. No completeness, finite-origin, or boundedness hypothesis is required for these two equalities.

lean.statement:
theorem cbcRefinementMap_functoriality
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (K : d.derived X) :
    (∀ c : Compactification f,
      cbcRefinementMap d (Compactification.Refinement.id c) K = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ (c₁ c₂ c₃ : Compactification f) (u : c₁.Refinement c₂) (v : c₂.Refinement c₃),
      cbcRefinementMap d (u.comp v) K =
        cbcRefinementMap d v K ≫ cbcRefinementMap d u K)
lean.note: The theorem is in the item module under coord/brief-stage3.md §3, since the actual cbcRefinementMap constructions are defined there. An external theorem module importing those constructions could not be imported by the consumer without a cycle. This is only the unit/composition portion of compactification coherence.
